gis.precision: Nayarin coordinate ed pinanlapuan, tinansya a sentro na Plus Code cell, sentro na hugis na bilding ed mapa, odino obserbasyon ed lugar iray punto. Aliwan prueba na katumpakan so dakel a decimal. Aliwan prueba so punto ed mapa na kasalukuyan a operasyon odino pagkatalaga bilang evacuation center. Nengnengen so pinanlapuan tan petsa.
gis.safety: Aliwa yan real-time a babala, ruta ed emerhensya odino serbisyo na kaligtasan na silungan. Ag usaren parad desisyon ed emerhensya. Tumawag ed 911 odino kontaken so Mapandan MDRRMO.

gis.limitations: Saray limitasyon tan babala ed kalidad
gis.project_link: Nengnengen so naisilpo a tala na proyekto
gis.reference_only: Direktoryo labat: anggapoy niiter a geometry ed mapa.
gis.flood_reference: Flood Susceptibility (Municipal Map): Opisyal a Source
gis.flood_info: I-on so Flood Susceptibility ed Natural Hazards pian nanengneng so registered historical overlay (off by default). Assumed so WGS84 datum, agni verified; say printed-grid registration tan duaran central candidate check et aliwan pruweba na ground accuracy odino certified scale. Agni segurado so petsa tan opisina a nanggawa na mapa; September 2, 2020 et attachment-page publication date labat. Walad municipal website so source, aliwan pruweba na rights ownership; anggapoy stated image-specific license. Saray lugar a anggapoy kolor et aliwan seguradon anggapoy delap. Aliwan live conditions, parcel risk, ruta odino shelter-safety advice. Kumpirmaen so balo a abiso ed lokal a disaster authorities.

gis.nonspatial: Tala ya anggapoy posisyon ed mapa. Anggapoy hinulaan a lokasyon.

Say lawak to et 32.92 square kilometers, tan antapud 3/4 na daga et para ed agrikultura—pangunahing palay, kaiba so mais, alaga a animales, tan pana-panahon a gulay. Mantrabaho so administrasyon na baley ed silong na tagline a “Kaakibat niyo ang Aktibo at Responsableng Liderato.”

homepage.milestone2_desc: Itinayneng bilang independent a munisipalidad diad Director General No. 39, panguloan na sampolokal a lider kaiba da Antonio Morales, Sabino Prado, tan Andres Bongato.

homepage.milestone4_desc: Sakey a munisipalidad ya 15 barangay tan 38,228 residente, ya mamuhunan ed Super Health Center, Pandan Festival, tan paglago na imprastraktura.

about.project_desc: Say Better Mapandan et independent civic transparency portal ya mangtitipon na pampublikong datos tungkol ed Municipality of Mapandan, Pangasinan ed sakey a madaling ma-access a platform. Binangon tan mantine na saray volunteer; aliwa iya kaakibat na local government.
about.project_mission_desc: Gawen a accessible, malinaw, tan magamit so lokal a government data para ed amin a residente na Mapandan, pian mapalakas so matalinong civic participation.
about.project_how_desc: Saray datos et titiponen manipud ed opisyal a government source a singa COA reports, PSA censuses, SP resolutions, tan municipal disclosures. Titiponen, i-verify, tan ipresenta na saray volunteer iya ed madaling gamitin a format.
about.project_open_source_desc: So source code na Better Mapandan et available ed publico ed GitHub, pian balang sakey et nayari a man-audit, mangikontribusyon, odino mang-fork ed proyekto.
about.project_independent_desc: Man-ooperate so Better Mapandan a independent ed amin a government entity. Sakey iya civic initiative ya amin a volunteer so mangasiwa.
about.project_volunteer_desc: Amin a panagtitipon na datos, beripikasyon, tan panangmantine na platform et gawa na saray volunteer contributor manipud ed komunidad.
about.contribute_get_involved_desc: Manlapud ed pakikilahok na komunidad so Better Mapandan. Wala so dakel a paraan pian mapaliwawa so portal.
about.contribute_report: I-ulat so Aliwan a Tama a Impormasyon
about.contribute_report_desc: Nakakita na eror? Tulongan kami a mapagtalona so datos diad panang-ulat na aliwan a tama odino luma a impormasyon.
about.contribute_code_desc: Saray developer et nayari a mangikontribusyon na features, mangtumpal na bugs, odino mangpa-maong ed platform diad panagsubmit na pull request ed GitHub.
about.contribute_verify_desc: Tulongan a i-verify so impormasyon na gobierno diad pagkumpara ed opisyal a dokumento tan publikasyon.
about.contribute_share_desc: Ipakalat so balita tungkol ed Better Mapandan pian mas dakel a residente so makaarap ed datos na local government.
about.disclaimer_desc: Say Better Mapandan et independent civic transparency portal. Aliwa iya kaakibat, inendorso, odino konektado ed Municipal Government of Mapandan odino arum a government agency. Amin a datos ya ipanengneng et tinipon manipud ed publicly available official sources tan para labat ed information.
